title: About
text:
Welcome to the EPM website! Here, you’ll find valuable insights into our services as both a training and consultancy company.
We provide training on the use of statistical software such as R, Python, SAS, and STATA, as well as practical guidance on conducting data analysis with these tools.
Our consultancy services include market research, data analysis, proposal writing, business plan development, statistical design, and analysis planning, among others.
You can book an initial call at https://calendly.com/ericodongo35/30min

title: Consulting Services
text: We offer consulting services in market research, survey design, advanced data analysis, proposal writing, business plans, design of experiments, statistical analysis plans among others. Our consulting services are custom-made according to the client needs and requirements. We will walk with you through all the major phases of consultancy which include Contact, Agreement, Information assessment, Feedback, Implementation, and Evaluation.

title: Training Services
text:
We offer training in the use of statistical packages like R, Python, SPSS, SAS, STATA among others. Our approach is hands-on always making sure that learners can actually use the tools effectively.
We also train people how to actually conduct data analysis using the given tools. We have expertise in clinical trial data analysis techniques like survival analysis, meta-analysis, etc, and we also excel in training common analysis methods in research like ANOVA, Regression, Mediation analysis, Multi-level modeling among others.

title: Company Profile
text:
Our divisions
We operate through two primary divisions, each designed to cater to specific needs:

1. Training Division
Our Training Division focuses on equipping individuals with hands-on experience in data analysis, research methodologies, statistical tools, and scientific software. We offer:

In-depth workshops and online courses covering statistical analysis, machine learning, and data visualization.
Practical training in tools such as Python, R, SPSS, SAS, and other relevant software tools.
Customized corporate training for businesses looking to upskill their teams.
One-on-one mentorship for students and professionals seeking personalized guidance.



2. Consultancy Division
Our Consultancy Division provides expert advice and solutions tailored to the specific needs of businesses, researchers, and institutions. Our services include:

Data analysis and interpretation for research projects and business analytics.
Statistical modeling, forecasting, and predictive analysis.
Assistance with research design, survey methodologies, and academic writing.
Custom solutions for organizations seeking to optimize their data-driven strategies.

For more details on each division, please visit their respective pages or contact us to discuss how we can support your data and research needs.

title: Sample Works
text:
Sample 01
In this project, the client sought a way to explore various statistical models to gain a deeper understanding of their data. Initially, they were estimating multiple models using Excel. We proposed an interactive solution—a Shiny app in R—that allows for more efficient model exploration.
The app offers a wide range of modeling options, including time series models, OLS regression, machine learning models, simplex regression, constrained regression, instrumental variable regression, Kalman filter models, and more.
This work is still in progress - the client still wants more features to be added and we are working on that.
Here is the link to the live app : https://4lt3sb-eric-odongo.shinyapps.io/shinyApp/

title: Sample Works
text:
Sample 02
The client wanted a detailed analysis of their data using Structural Equation Modeling technique. The analysis was carried out using R software package.
Extensive analysis was conducted, including descriptive analysis, visualizations, and statistical modeling. Assumptions of the model were tested thoroughly.
A link to the pdf report is here : https://github.com/rikoprogrammer/SEM_analysis/blob/main/SEM_analysis.pdf
